question: With a stretch of about 724 km, which river is one of the most important rivers of peninsular India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tapi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tapi, also known as the Tapti River**, is one of the most important rivers of peninsular India.
 
• It originates in the Satpura Range of Madhya Pradesh and flows through Maharashtra and Gujarat before draining into the Arabian Sea.
 
• **The river has a total length of about 724 km, making it one of the longest rivers in peninsular India.**
 
• The Tapi River is an important source of water for irrigation, hydropower generation, and drinking water supply for the people living in the region.
